evidence_text: Amazon’s 1997 SEC S-1 financial statements identify July 5, 1994 as company inception; same filing states Amazon was founded in July 1994.
American Tower’s official corporate profile states that it was founded in 1995; no day or month is stated.
Apple states it was founded on April 1, 1976.
Caterpillar’s official centennial release says the company officially turns 100 on April 15, 2025, establishing April 15, 1925 as its formation date.
The Walt Disney Company officially began on October 16, 1923, when Walt Disney signed the Alice Comedies contract.
ExxonMobil states Exxon and Mobil joined to form Exxon Mobil Corporation on November 30, 1999.
Ford records that Henry Ford and 12 others created Ford Motor Company on June 16, 1903.
Freeport-McMoRan Inc.'s SEC-filed amended certificate states its original certificate of incorporation was filed with Delaware on November 10, 1987.
GE records that Edison Electric Company merged with Thomson & Houston to form General Electric on April 15, 1892.
JPMorganChase’s 2025 shareholder letter states that it was founded in April 1799; the source does not disclose a founding day.
Microsoft’s official developer blog identifies April 4, 1975 as Microsoft’s founding date.
Netflix SEC filing states it was incorporated on August 29, 1997 (inception).
Wikidata P571 inception claim for Q1785405.
NextEra Energy’s investor financial policy states that NEE was incorporated in 1984; the source does not disclose an incorporation day.
Pfizer’s official company history states that Charles Pfizer and Charles Erhart founded Charles Pfizer & Company in 1849; the source does not disclose a founding day.
Prologis' SEC-filed prospectus states Prologis Inc. began operating as a fully integrated real estate company in 1997.
Tesla Investor Relations states Tesla was incorporated on July 1, 2003.
Wikidata P571 inception claim for Q2103926.
Visa’s official company history identifies 1958 as the beginning of its payments business lineage; the source does not disclose a founding day.
Walmart’s official history records Sam Walton opened the first Walmart store on July 2, 1962, the operating-life anchor used for this company.
